headline: ISSUE MOMENTUM
headline_accent: ICE, GUNS AND IRAN HEAT UP
dek: Online heat, day over day. Pocketbook issues voters rank highest cooled online.

means.label: Online vs. voters:
means.text: Cost of Living remains voters' No. 1 priority category (polling as of Nov. 16), yet grocery prices cooled online.

means.label: Top single issue:
means.text: Health care costs & insurance premiums leads voter priority (polling as of Nov. 16); its online heat fell 8%.

means.label: Comparable days:
means.text: 60 issues had heat both days; 155,619 messages Nov. 23 vs. 150,849 Nov. 24.

sources: Whip data: online heat is relative within each day; change compares Nov. 23 and Nov. 24, 2026 (60 issues each; 155,619 and 150,849 messages). Voter priority from polling as of Nov. 16, 2026. Source: api.whipcampaigns.com/civic, pulled Nov. 25, 2026.
